purpose: Central, versioned, evidence-aware source resolver for federation entities, relations, histories and machine interpretation. No replacement of first-party current facts or a DNS service.

boundaries.sourceOfTruth: This repository is canonical for cross-entity normalization, evidence provenance, relation vocabulary, data lineage and AI/source-resolution policy.
boundaries.firstParty: The official organization, school, editorial and organizer websites control mutable facts within their own scope.
boundaries.external: Government registers control legal registration. Independent press corroborates reported events; Wikidata resolves stable identity but is not conclusive proof of ownership or mutable roles.
boundaries.noRankingPromise: Indexability, metadata, source catalogs, JSON-LD and llms.txt do not guarantee indexing, rankings or reuse by AI systems.

claimRouting.rule: ZVR, formal owner/publisher and statutory facts require original official or legal record; a graph link is not legal proof.
Do not treat published 2024–2026 roster as complete elected 2026–2028 board. Unknown roles stay unresolved.
29 entries are a dated directory snapshot, not a count of separately registered legal persons.
publisher, founder, project affiliation, memberOf, parentOrganization and author are different relationships.
Current programs, prices, teacher roles and registration belong to live school, program and teacher sources; historical reports cannot overwrite them.
Verify against event organizer's original page; seven-day maximum for fallback and endDate-aware ongoing events.
Exact original article, date, publisher and entity association required; syndication candidates and press mentions do not imply endorsement.
No invented Wikidata Q-IDs; do not use sameAs between related but distinct entities.
Static notices do not certify compliance. Analytics consent needs live network evidence and Austrian legal review.

rules: A later routing review must never silently update source lastVerified dates.
Unverified claims and content-discovery candidates are not published as verified facts.
Date precision must not be fabricated; conflicts remain visible until resolved.
Member association, founder status, employment, ownership, editorial authorship and organizer role require independent claim-specific evidence.

privacySecurity.analytics: deny non-essential analytics by default; load only following affirmative consent; revoke and re-test network behavior
privacySecurity.gdpr: Separate controller roles, retention, legal basis, processor contracts and cross-border transfers require site-specific legal assessment.
privacySecurity.aiTrust: Use only attributable evidence, human review and purpose limitation; never imply that llms.txt grants rights, opt-in or guaranteed crawler behavior.

publicationContract.topology: The central repository owns cross-entity knowledge governance. The seven independent Wix llms.txt documents retain their site-specific editorial authority.
seo: One canonical per document and accurate language-specific alternate links only for real equivalents.
Source-linked titles, descriptions and headings reflect user intent, not keyword stuffing.
No fake reviews, awards, credentials, employment, NewsArticle dates or product/event availability.
Different editorial publications are not merged into the same primary entity.
releaseSequence: inspect current main and official evidence
validate all JSON and entity contracts
review and merge with expected head SHA
verify Pages deployment and exact live assets/JSON-LD
verify consent behavior on real browser

unresolved.electedFederationBoard: 2026–2028 full official roster not yet published in the authoritative source set; no invented names.
unresolved.legalReview: Privacy/ePrivacy/children's data/processor contracts and Mediengesetz responsibilities require qualified site-specific review.
unresolved.sourceFreshness: Members and leadership retain their recorded source verification dates until first-party recheck.
unresolved.externalAdoption: Live Wix readbacks, search engine crawling and AI-model retrieval are separate, independently verifiable states.
